records.text: A Turning Point USA insider told Candace Owens that Marcus Wada creates AI-generated voices for the organization's presentations and that it typically uses an AI version of Pastor John Amanchukwu's voice.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep KpxIBWkNsSs)

appearances.snippet: And Marcus Wada, one of the things that he offers is that he is able to create these AI voices for them to use for their presentations. So AI technology is what they currently use to voice over their Turning Point presentations. And typically, I am told they use the voice of Pastor John Amanchukwu.

verification.notes: Live research confirms Marcus Wada is a Turning Point USA productions director and confirms John Amanchukwu is affiliated with TPUSA Faith, but no named insider, authenticated internal record, presentation asset, or public statement verifies that Wada creates AI narration or that the organization typically clones Amanchukwu voice. The anonymous-source allegation remains unresolved.
